unit: clip; source works also kept together
method: Korky and Tears of Steel for calibration; Duck and Cover and NASA for held-out evaluation. All labels for a clip stay together. Only declared caption frames are scored; unlabeled clips are not negatives.
limitations: The V1 report and task already disclosed Duck title failures. Held-out means no CG2 threshold tuning on these clips, not an unseen benchmark. Five primary labeled frames, eleven lines and one separately reported post-hoc Korky negative cannot establish broad accuracy. No numeric fill-color ground truth exists in V1 labels.
